articles.summary: Acquisition enhances Alight’s benefits intelligence capabilities to help employees make more informed decisions and enable employers to increase engagement, optimize utilization and manage the benefits ecosystem performance
articles.title: Alight announces acquisition of Abett to accelerate benefits outcomes through data, intelligence and action

articles.summary: The 2026 Alight U.S. Employee Mindset Study finds 45% of employees worry their money and savings won’t last and 67% regret a healthcare decision they made in the past year, highlighting the business imperative for employers to help workers navigate their benefits.
articles.title: Better wellbeing, bigger worries: Alight research finds financial stress and healthcare complexity continue to challenge employees
